level2.title: The Spirit of Truth
level2.story: Jesus said to His disciples, "I have yet many things to say to you: but you cannot bear them now." He said, "When He, the Spirit of truth, is come, He will teach you all truth." The Spirit would not speak on His own but would tell them what He hears. Jesus said, "He shall glorify Me; because He shall receive of Mine, and shall shew it to you." Jesus said, "All things whatsoever the Father hath, are Mine."
level2.keyLine: When he, the Spirit of truth, is come, he will teach you all truth.
